thread:
mike_ops: Heads up — vendor just flagged a DOA batch (12 units) at origin. They want to route repairs through their Tokyo repair hub instead of the EU depot.

sana_supply: Can you paste the AWB + serials? We need to check insurance coverage and customs impact.

vendor_rep_jp: Sorry for the headache. AWB: JP1234567890. Serials: SN-A1001..A1012 (12). Cause: transit vibration detected, units failing POST. We can do depot swap in NRT repair hub, 5-7 business days once accepted.

lee_logistics: If we go NRT we’ll need a temporary import declaration for the repair flow. That adds ~48h paperwork to the timeline. Customs might request invoice amendment.

mike_ops: Time-sensitive because clusters in eu-west-1 are already down 60 GPUs. We need at least 8 replacement units ASAP. Is vendor offering air-ship loaners?

vendor_rep_jp: We have 8 loaner H100s available, can ship overnight from NRT to FRA via airbridge. Cost: vendor covers transit but asks for refundable deposit for loaners. Will include repaired units later.

tara_finance: Deposit details? We need PO amendment. What amount and terms?

vendor_rep_jp: Deposit USD 200k refundable on return in original condition, or vendor proposes invoicing repaired units and crediting deposit back.

sana_supply: That deposit is higher than expected. Can we instead accept partial depot repair: 4 units swapped locally in FRA and 4 loaners airbridge? Mix reduces deposit and customs hops.

lee_logistics: FRA depot can accept 4 immediate swaps but requires serial manifest and test evidence photos. If we do mixed flow, we must split AWBs and update insurance endorsements.

mike_ops: Quick decision: prioritize minimizing downtime. I vote 4 FRA swaps + 4 loaners. Can vendor confirm pickup ETA and provide repair estimate SLA?

vendor_rep_jp: Confirmed. FRA pickup pickup window TOM 09:00-12:00 local. Loaner AWB JP9876543210 — ETA FRA +1 day from pickup. Repair SLA at NRT hub 7 business days after arrival.

deploybot: Shipping update: AWB JP9876543210 scanned - manifest accepted by carrier (tracking link: https://carrier.example/JP9876543210)

tara_finance: I'll scope PO amendment for the deposit on the 4 loaners only, ask legal for expedited review of refundable terms.

sana_supply: Also need handoff checklist for the FRA depot tests. Lee — can you post the minimal acceptance checklist we hand to depot?

lee_logistics: Checklist (short): 1) Visual inspection photos 2) POST boot log (serial tied) 3) Cooling plate torque check 4) AWB + manifest copy. I'll DM the template.

mike_ops: Good. One more — confirm whether repaired units will be returned to us or consigned to vendor pool. We want replacements back into our eu pool.

vendor_rep_jp: Repaired units will be returned to your EU pool. We will provide RMA labels + customs CN23 for repair flow. We'll email formal RMA docs within 2h.

sana_supply: Perfect. I'll prep customs contact and let FRA depot know to expect a mixed manifest.

mike_ops: Thanks everyone — keep updates short here. If anything changes on AWBs or customs, ping @mike_ops and include manifest.

lee_logistics: Noted. Adding tagging instructions: tag returned units with our internal tag: RW-REPL-2026 before ingestion.

vendor_rep_jp: RMA docs sent to sara@redwood.com, subject: "RMA NRT->FRA mixed-flow". Will follow up if customs requests further paperwork.

mike_ops: Closing action list: (1) tara -> PO amendment for deposit, (2) lee -> depot checklist + tag process, (3) sana -> customs prep, (4) vendor -> RMA docs + AWB copies. Expect next update on delivery scans.

tara_finance: On it, will share draft PO by EOD.

deploybot: Tracking update: AWB JP1234567890 status: Held for inspection at origin, reason: anomaly flagged.
